notice: Hand labels for corpus.json. 'worth_surfacing' is the human judgment; 'title' and 'quote' are the one expected decision and its verbatim evidence. 'pitch' scripts the undiscriminating model double the precision/recall run uses: what it would say about that record if it pitched on every record. A pitch quote that is not in the record is deliberately invented so the citation check has something to refuse.
